label: r1c2
name: Frames x centred window x orders
hypothesis: One shared centred (2K-1) window conv produces type maps for every frame. Each map is flattened both type-major and anchor-major, and a ×5 softmax picks among them. This covers anchor-offset and flattening-order mismatches as well as frame transforms. A small dense term from the global vector is added. The idea is refuted if this scores 0 while candidate 1 scores above 0. That would mean the window and order options only cost samples.
